sampling_note: Source workbook supplied as fixed-seed stratified sample; the seed and sampling algorithm were not independently reconstructed in this review.
scope: Question-level semantic review using the supplied oracle passage; selective external checks for ambiguous or suspect references. C1 Top-5 and L3 were not re-reviewed.
metrics_policy: Do not overwrite frozen judge labels, rescore the whole sweep, extrapolate raw 50/50 counts, or promote these assistant labels to human-confirmed labels.
